newsitem.title: UK: UK s/adj M0 rises to 24.742 bln stg in week.
newsitem.headline: UK s/adj M0 rises to 24.742 bln stg in week.

text.p: UK M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 24.742 billion stg in the week to December 4 from 24.710 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said.
Unadjusted M0 was 25.151 billion stg compared with 24.718 billion stg.
Notes and coins in circulation totalled 24.655 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis compared with 24.665 billion.
Unadjusted notes and coins rose to 25.064 billion stg from 24.673 billion the previous week.
